native.reason: Skia, Google's open-source 2D graphics library (SkiaSharp 2.88.9), which Avalonia and the charts draw with. Its import table names no networking library (kernel32, user32, ole32, fontsub).
HarfBuzz, the open-source text shaping library (HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.1), which lays out text for Avalonia. Its import table names no networking library (kernel32 only).

ANGLE, Google's open-source OpenGL ES implementation on Direct3D (Avalonia.Angle.Windows.Natives 2.1.25547.20250602), which Avalonia renders through on Windows. Its import table names no networking library (kernel32, user32, dxgi).
